totp.title: Two-factor authentication
totp.intro: Require a code from an authenticator app when you sign in.
totp.setupIntro: Add this account to your authenticator app by entering the secret manually (or the otpauth link if your app accepts it), then enter the code it shows.
totp.disableWarn: Your account will be protected by your password alone.
totp.codesIntro: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe. Each works once if you lose your authenticator. They won't be shown again.
sessions.title: Devices
audit.title: Recent account activity
audit.intro: Sign-ins and security changes on your account.
push.title: Notifications on this device
push.privacy: Browser notifications are delivered through your browser vendor's push service (Google, Apple or Mozilla). The message is end-to-end encrypted, but the vendor can see that a notification was sent to your device and when.
push.failed: Could not turn on notifications in this browser.
push.unsupported: This browser does not support push notifications. Use a channel above instead.
push.insecure: Push notifications need a secure connection (HTTPS). Open Gunkly over HTTPS to enable them.
export.accountIntro: Download a copy of your account data as a JSON file: profile, preferences, household memberships, the chores you completed, the names of your notification channels (never their addresses), your devices and your sign-in history.
emailSection.title: Email address
emailSection.none: No email address on this account.
emailSection.unverifiedNote: Confirm it with the link we emailed to reset your password by email or use email codes.
emailSection.sent: Check your inbox: we sent a confirmation link to the new address. It only changes once you open it.
emailSection.hint: We email a link to the new address and tell the old one. Nothing changes until the link is opened.
emailcodes.title: Email codes
emailcodes.intro: Get a 6-digit code by email each time you sign in, instead of using an authenticator app.
emailcodes.mailbox: Anyone who can open your email can use these codes and reset your password. An authenticator app is stronger.
emailcodes.mandatory: Two-factor authentication is required on this server. Switch to an authenticator app to stop using email codes.
totp.replacesEmail: Setting this up replaces email codes.
totp.mandatory: Two-factor authentication is required on this server, so it can't be turned off.
delete.title: Delete account
delete.intro: Deleting your account removes your profile, sign-ins, notification channels and personal data for good. Chores you completed stay in your households as "Deleted user".
delete.households: These households have no other member who can use them and will be deleted with their chores:
tokens.title: Integrations
tokens.intro: Let other apps use Gunkly on your behalf with an access token, for example Home Assistant or an AI assistant that speaks MCP. Each token is limited to the households and permissions you choose, and can be revoked at any time.
tokens.needHouseholdFirst: Create or join a household first.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.nameHint: What it is for, for example Home Assistant.
tokens.permissionsHint: A token can never change members, settings, notification channels or your account, and never delete a household. It also never does more than your own role in a household allows.
tokens.scopeComplete: Mark chores done, snooze, skip and pause them
tokens.scopeWrite: Add, change and delete chores and their reminders
tokens.once: Copy this token now and keep it secret. It won't be shown again, and anyone who has it can use it within the permissions you chose.
tokens.revokeWarn: Anything using this token stops working at once. This can't be undone.
audit.token_complete: Chore completed with an access token
